item.title: Christ Alone: Leaving New Age Universalism Behind
item.description: Doreen Virtue shares how God opened her eyes to the truth that Jesus Christ is the only way—leaving New Age universalism and trusting the gospel alone.

item.title: Why Expositional Preaching Is Essential for the Local Church
item.description: Dave Jenkins explains why expositional, verse-by-verse preaching is vital for the health of the local church, grounded in 2 Timothy 4:1–2.

item.title: Job 21: When the Wicked Prosper and God’s Justice Seems Delayed
item.description: In Job 21, Job confronts the reality that the wicked often prosper while the righteous suffer, reminding us that God’s justice may appear delayed but is never denied.

item.title: Worship in Spirit and Truth: Biblical Worship That Honors God
item.description: Dave Jenkins answers the question: What does it mean to worship God in spirit and truth? A biblical explanation from John 4 focused on Christ-centered worship.

item.title: Job 22: False Accusation, Repentance, and the Grace of God
item.description: A verse-by-verse study of Job 22 showing the danger of false accusations, misused doctrine, and how repentance and grace restore what condemnation destroys.

item.title: Biblical Literacy: God’s Safeguard Against Deception
item.description: In this Weekly Watch episode of Contending for the Word, Dave Jenkins explains why biblical literacy is not optional for the Christian life and how Scripture protects believers from deception in a deceptive age.
